# Introduction to Raster Data

## Gridded Spatial Matrices
* Raster data models space as a matrix of pixels containing continuous or categorical values (e.g. elevation, sea surface temperature).
* Core library: **terra** (faster successor to the old `raster` package).
* Raster file format: GeoTIFF (`.tif`).

---

# Loading & Mapping Rasters

## Reading Rasters in R
* Use `rast()` to load rasters:
  ```r
  library(terra)
  library(tidyverse)
  
  # Load elevation model raster
  dem <- rast(here("data", "dem_morogoro.tif"))
  
  # Print metadata (resolution, columns, CRS)
  print(dem)
  ```

---

# Raster Algebra & Extraction

## Computing Raster Calculations
* Modifying pixels (e.g. converting elevation to feet, computing indices):
  ```r
  # Convert DEM values to feet
  dem_feet <- dem * 3.28084
  ```

## Extracting Values at Vector Points
* Overlay coordinates on top of rasters to extract pixel values:
  ```r
  library(sf)
  
  # Extract elevation values for our survey locations
  stns <- st_read(here("data", "stations.shp"))
  stns_elev <- terra::extract(dem, stns)
  ```
